WITH per_timespan AS (
  SELECT o."timespan", COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count
  FROM "riskandmargin" AS r
  JOIN "orders" AS o
    ON r."ordervault" = o."recordvault"
  GROUP BY o."timespan"
), shares AS (
  SELECT "timespan",
         risk_margin_count,
         risk_margin_count::numeric / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
  FROM per_timespan
)
SELECT "timespan",
       risk_margin_count,
       share_of_total,
       share_of_total - AVG(share_of_total) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share
FROM shares;

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the unweighted mean of the shares for time-in-force values represented among matched risk/margin records; NULL time-in-force values, if present, form a value group.
